## Component

- **Category / slug**: `components/<category>/<slug>/`
- **Variants**: vanilla / react / vue

## Checklist

- [ ] `meta.json` fields match the folder names (kebab-case)
- [ ] CSS classes are prefixed so snippets don't collide
- [ ] Animations honor `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Interactive elements are keyboard-accessible with visible focus
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally
